subject: Vendor onboarding: payment rails details and invoice tag mapping
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elsa Mathews <elsa@keystone-ops.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Keystone onboarding — payment rails and PO tags (next steps)

Hi Elsa,

Thanks for completing the vendor intake form earlier today. To finish payment activation on our side we need two things: 1) the signed bank proof (a PDF with bank letter or voided check) and 2) confirmation of how you want invoice metadata mapped to our PO fields.

I attached a quick PO-field mapping template — if you can populate the right-hand column with the exact invoice field names you use (e.g., "Bill To", "Invoice ID", "Remit Ref") we'll ingest that into our AP pipeline.

Target timeline: once we receive the signed bank proof we'll trigger micro-deposits (typically within 24 hours) and confirm the first micro-deposit amounts by reply. Expect the first payment window 3 business days after verification.

Attachments: PO-field-mapping.xlsx (template)

Quick asks:
- Can you send the signed bank proof today?
- Confirm whether Keystone uses a company-level remit reference or individual invoice-level remit on payments.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Elsa Mathews <elsa@keystone-ops.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Keystone onboarding — payment rails and PO tags (next steps)

Hi Mateo,

Thanks — attaching what you requested.

Files attached: keystone_bankinfo_signed.pdf (bank letter, stamped), micro-deposit-stub.txt (note with expected micro-deposit schedule).

On mapping: Keystone sends an "Remit ID" on each invoice and we also include a single company-level AZN code in the invoice header. For best reconciliation, map our invoice-level "Remit ID" to your PO_remit_reference field and keep AZN as a static vendor tag. I filled out the template with the exact invoice field names — see sheet "Keystone mapping".

Let me know if anything needs clarification.

Best,
Elsa Mathews
Finance Lead, Keystone Ops
Elsa@keystone-ops.com
Attachment: keystone_bankinfo_signed.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: micro-deposit-stub.txt (text)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elsa Mathews <elsa@keystone-ops.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Keystone onboarding — payment rails and PO tags (next steps)

Hi Elsa — got the files, thank you. A couple quick clarifying questions from FinOps:

- Is the bank letter for ACH only, or does it include clearing instructions for wire/CT (ABA + acct number)? If wires are supported, please confirm preferred wire beneficiary name exactly as it appears at the bank.
- On the micro-deposit schedule: we usually send two small deposits. The stub you attached references two deposits on Apr 19 — can you confirm you will monitor the account and share the amounts once they hit?

If everything checks out we will authorize vendor activation and pull the PO-field mapping into our ingestion script.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Payments Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: PO-field-mapping.xlsx (completed by Keystone)

From: Elsa Mathews <elsa@keystone-ops.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Keystone onboarding — payment rails and PO tags (next steps)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the checks. Confirmations below:
- Bank letter covers both ACH and wire instructions. Wire beneficiary: Keystone Operations LLC (exact).
- We will monitor and report the two micro-deposit amounts as soon as they post; finance@keystone-ops.com will reply with the amounts.

I also included the signed W-9 in case you need tax proof (W-9.pdf).

Regards,
Elsa
Attachment: W-9.pdf (PDF)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elsa Mathews <elsa@keystone-ops.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T14:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Keystone onboarding — payment rails and PO tags (next steps)

Perfect — thanks everyone.

I ran a quick validation on the attached bank letter and the wire beneficiary name matches our legal-on-file. We will:
1) start the micro-deposit flow now (payments team)
2) ingest the PO-field mapping into the invoicing pipeline by EOD today
3) send a confirmation once micro-deposits are verified and then schedule the first payable window (expected within 3 business days).

Checklist / next steps for visibility:
- Keystone: reply to this thread with the two micro-deposit amounts when they post.
- Redwood: once deposits verified we will move Keystone to active payee status and add AZN as a vendor tag in the ledger.

If anything changes, I will escalate to Jordan for SLA exception routing.

Thanks — Mateo
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
